title: DS-CORE: runtime environment, client drivers and bulk import
summary: Closes three taxonomy gaps: supported runtime platforms and Kubernetes operator (constraint/environment, flexibility), official drivers in six languages (compatibility), and bulk import from CSV/JSON Lines, Neo4j and MongoDB exports (data/migration).
rationale: PO decisions 2026-10-05: Linux x86-64 + ARM64 on bare metal/VMs plus a Kubernetes operator; drivers for Java, Python, Go, JavaScript/TypeScript, Rust and C#/.NET; import from generic CSV/JSON Lines, Neo4j (Cypher/GraphML) and MongoDB (BSON/Extended JSON).

data.title: Supported platforms
data.statement: The system shall run on Linux on x86-64 and ARM64 processors, on bare-metal servers and virtual machines.
data.rationale: PO decision: Linux x86-64 and ARM64 on bare metal/VMs.

acceptance_criteria.text: Each release publishes server binaries for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64.
The full release test suite, including the Jepsen-style suite, passes on both linux/amd64 and linux/arm64.
A cluster mixing amd64 and arm64 nodes passes the transaction test suite.

data.notes: Open: minimum Linux kernel and glibc versions.

data.title: Kubernetes operator
data.statement: The system shall provide a Kubernetes operator that brings a declared 3-node cluster to a ready, serving state within 10 minutes of the cluster resource being applied.
data.rationale: PO decision: Kubernetes operator in addition to bare metal/VMs.

acceptance_criteria.text: On each of the 3 most recent Kubernetes minor releases, applying a 3-node cluster resource yields a cluster that accepts authenticated GQL reads and writes within 10 minutes.
Changing the declared node count from 3 to 5 adds nodes and rebalances replicas with zero failed client requests.
Changing the declared version performs a rolling upgrade that meets REQ-0021 acceptance criteria.

data.title: Official client drivers
data.statement: The system shall provide official client drivers for Java, Python, Go, JavaScript/TypeScript, Rust and C#/.NET, each passing 100% of the shared driver conformance suite.
data.rationale: PO decision: six officially supported driver languages.

acceptance_criteria.text: A shared conformance suite (connection, authentication, GQL execution, transactions, retryable serialization-conflict error, typed value round-trip) passes 100% for each of the six drivers.
Each driver is published to its ecosystem registry (Maven Central, PyPI, Go modules, npm, NuGet, crates.io) with every server release.
Each driver passes the conformance suite against the current and previous server minor versions.

data.title: Bulk import throughput
data.statement: The system shall bulk-import graph data at a sustained rate of at least 50,000 nodes plus edges per second on a 3-node cluster.
data.rationale: Customers need to move existing data into DS-CORE in hours, not days. Rate is a starting target for PO confirmation.

acceptance_criteria.text: Importing 100 million nodes and 500 million edges from CSV on a 3-node SSD cluster sustains ≥ 50,000 elements per second averaged over the run.
Invalid records are written to a reject file with source location and reason, and all valid records are imported.
An import interrupted by a node failure can be resumed and completes without duplicate nodes or edges.

data.title: Import from CSV and JSON Lines
data.statement: The system shall import nodes and edges from CSV and JSON Lines files using a documented mapping for identifiers, labels, edge endpoints, edge types and properties.

acceptance_criteria.text: A sample dataset of node and edge files in CSV and in JSON Lines imports to a graph whose node count, edge count and property values match the source exactly.

data.title: Import from Neo4j exports
data.statement: The system shall import Neo4j exports in Cypher-script and GraphML formats, preserving node labels, relationship types, direction and properties.
data.rationale: PO decision: Neo4j is a likely migration source for graph users.

acceptance_criteria.text: A reference Neo4j database exported as Cypher script and as GraphML imports with identical node, relationship, label, type and property counts.
Neo4j property types without a DS-CORE equivalent are converted per a documented mapping table or reported in the reject file.

data.title: Import from MongoDB exports
data.statement: The system shall import MongoDB exports in BSON and Extended JSON as nodes, converting user-configured reference fields into edges.
data.rationale: PO decision: MongoDB documents carry no edges; references must be mapped explicitly.

acceptance_criteria.text: A mongodump BSON export and a mongoexport Extended JSON export each import as one node per document, labelled by collection, with int64, decimal128, date and binary values preserved.

With a mapping declaring field orders.customer_id as an edge of type PLACED_BY to customers, every order node has exactly one PLACED_BY edge to its customer node; unresolved references are listed in the reject file.

data.title: Linux x86-64/ARM64 plus Kubernetes operator
data.context: Runtime environments for v1: options included VM-only, Helm-only, or operator-only.
data.decision: Support Linux on x86-64 and ARM64 on bare metal and VMs, plus a Kubernetes operator.

data.title: Six official driver languages
data.context: Driver scope options ranged from Go only to six languages.
data.decision: Official drivers for Java, Python, Go, JavaScript/TypeScript, Rust and C#/.NET, held to one shared conformance suite.

data.title: Bulk import sources for v1
data.context: Candidate sources: generic CSV/JSON Lines, Neo4j, MongoDB, relational CSV with FK mapping.
data.decision: Support CSV/JSON Lines node and edge files, Neo4j Cypher/GraphML exports and MongoDB BSON/Extended JSON exports; relational FK mapping deferred.

impact_notes.stories: None exist yet; no story links change.
impact_notes.code: No components configured; no code or trace tags affected.
impact_notes.evals: None yet. Planning must add: cross-architecture CI matrix (amd64/arm64), a Kubernetes e2e eval across 3 K8s versions, a shared driver conformance suite run per language, an import performance eval and import correctness evals per source.
risks: Six drivers is a large ongoing maintenance surface; each must track every protocol change.
Import rate 50,000 elements/s and K8s ready-in-10-minutes are starting targets awaiting PO confirmation.
Minimum Linux kernel/glibc versions are still open.
